item.title: Turkey's trade minister says day-trip crossings halted at Iranian border
item.description: Turkey's trade minister says day-trip crossings halted at Iranian border Turkey's trade minister said on Monday that day-trip passenger crossings at three Turkish customs gates at the Iranian border have been mutually suspended but Turkey is allowing its own citizens and third-country nationals to enter from Iran. item.title: Israeli attacks on Lebanon kill at least 31, health ministry says
item.description: Israeli attacks on Lebanon kill at least 31, health ministry says Israeli air attacks on Lebanon have killed at least 31 people and wounded 149, the health ministry has said on Monday. According to a report by Lebanon’s National News Agency, 20 people were killed, and 91 were wounded in the capital’s suburbs, while 11 were killed and 58 were wounded in the country’s south. Smoke rises after Israeli strikes in Beirut's southern suburbs, Lebanon, 2 March 2026. (Reuters/Mohamed Azakir)

item.title: Smoke rising from US embassy in Kuwait City
item.description: Smoke rising from US embassy in Kuwait City Black smoke was seen rising from the US embassy in Kuwait City on Monday after the latest volley of Iranian strikes. The US Embassy in Kuwait said that there is a continuing threat of missile and drone attacks over the country, urging people not to come to the embassy and to take cover.

item.title: Video: Fire burns inside US naval base in Bahrain
item.description: Video: Fire burns inside US naval base in Bahrain Footage circulating online shows intense flames burning inside a US naval facility in Bahrain. The fire is being attributed in reports to an Iranian strike on the base, which hosts key US naval operations in the region, including the United States Fifth Fleet and US Central Command. item.title: Explosions heard near Iraq's Erbil airport
item.description: Explosions heard near Iraq's Erbil airport Loud bangs were heard on Monday near Iraq's Erbil airport, which hosts US-led coalition troops, an AFP journalist said. Earlier Monday, an AFP photographer said that air defence systems downed drones near the airport. Since the start of the US-Israel campaign against Iran, drones have repeatedly been intercepted over Erbil, which is also home to a major US consulate complex.

item.title: Report: Small fire under control at Saudi Aramco refinery after apparent drone strike
item.description: Report: Small fire under control at Saudi Aramco refinery after apparent drone strike A small, isolated fire is under control at Saudi Aramco's 2222.SE Ras Tanura refining facility following what appeared to be a drone strike earlier in the morning, a Semafor reporter said in a post on X on Monday, citing sources.

item.title: EU stands with member states in face of any threat, von der Leyen says
item.description: EU stands with member states in face of any threat, von der Leyen says The EU stands with its member states in the face of any threat, EU Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said in response to the drone strike that hit Britain's Royal Air Force base of Akrotiri in Cyprus overnight. item.title: In photos: Aftermath of Israeli strikes on Lebanon
item.description: In photos: Aftermath of Israeli strikes on Lebanon A damaged building is shown after an Israeli air strike in Beirut's southern suburb of Haret Hreik, Lebanon, on 2 March, 2026. (AFP) Israel bombarded Beirut's southern suburb of Haret Hreik on 2 March 2026, expanding conflict across the region after the massive Israel-US attack on Iran. (AFP) People check the wreckage of cars damaged in an Israeli air strike in the southern Beirut suburb of Haret Hreik on 2 March 2026. (AFP)

item.title: Three killed in US-Israeli strikes on western Iran, state media says
